title: WorldRuler: Interactive World Modeling under Configurable Rules
abstract: arXiv:2611.24869v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rules govern how player actions change interactive worlds. Different rules create distinct gameplay experiences within similar scenes and action spaces. For customizable gameplay, generative world models must follow user-defined rules beyond real-world behaviors. However, realizing user-defined rules presents two challenges: Rule-State Persistence and Rule-to-Visual Realization. The former requires preserving rule definitions, dependencies, and world states across saving and loading, so that restored worlds follow the established rules. The latter requires accurately realizing rule-induced changes on designated objects and attributes, particularly when affected objects are unseen. In this paper, we propose WorldRuler, which organizes rule definitions, dependencies, and object states in an executable 3D rule graph and connects rule execution, video generation, and perceptual feedback in a closed loop. translated_title: WorldRuler：可配置规则下的交互式世界建模
translated_abstract: 规则支配着玩家行为如何改变交互式世界。在相似的场景和动作空间中，不同的规则会创造出截然不同的游戏体验。为了实现可定制的游戏玩法，生成式世界模型必须能够遵循用户定义的规则，而不仅仅局限于现实世界的行为。然而，实现用户定义的规则面临两大挑战：规则-状态持久化和规则到视觉的实现。前者要求在保存和加载过程中保持规则定义、依赖关系和世界状态，使恢复后的世界遵循既定规则；后者要求准确地将规则引发的变化体现在指定对象和属性上，尤其是当受影响对象不可见时。本文提出WorldRuler，它将规则定义、依赖关系和对象状态组织在一个可执行的3D规则图中，并将规则执行、视频生成和感知反馈连接成一个闭环。该图支持联合保存与恢复等功能。
tldr: WorldRuler通过可执行的3D规则图组织规则定义、依赖关系与对象状态，并闭环连接规则执行、视频生成和感知反馈，使生成式世界模型能够遵循用户自定义规则，解决了规则-状态持久化与规则到视觉实现两大挑战。
en_tdlr: WorldRuler introduces an executable 3D rule graph that organizes rule definitions, dependencies, and object states in a closed loop connecting rule execution, video generation, and perceptual feedback, enabling generative world models to follow user-defined rules while addressing rule-state persistence and rule-to-visual realization.
